mapper.sql: select message_id, user_id, user_name, message_title, message_content, message_type, biz_id, read_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from edu_message_center
mapper.insert: insert into edu_message_center(user_id, user_name, message_title, message_content, message_type, biz_id, read_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{userId}, #{userName}, #{messageTitle}, #{messageContent}, #{messageType}, #{bizId}, #{readStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update edu_message_center set del_flag='2' where message_id in #{messageId}
update edu_message_center set read_status='1', update_time=sysdate() where message_id = #{messageId}
